purpose: V2-P02R §2 — freeze the code state before any live evidence is collected. Live LAB evidence must point to an identifiable code version.
why_this_is_blocking_per_v2_p02r_section: V2-P02R explicitly requires an immutable source identifier before live LAB evidence can be tied to it. Live evidence pointing at a dirty workspace cannot be reproduced or audited later. Since I am not authorized to create a commit on the operator's behalf (per Executing-actions-with-care safety policy and the auto-mode default), I record LIVE_CODE_STATE = DIRTY_UNFROZEN and BLOCK certification. This is exactly the branch V2-P02R §2 anticipates.
operator_options_to_unblock_source_state: Option 1 (preferred): commit the intended V2-P00R + V2-P01 + V2-P01R remediation state (with untracked new tests and manifests) into a checkpoint branch — for example `v2-p02r-live-pilot-checkpoint` — and re-invoke V2-P02R against that commit. Never commit `.env` or any secret.
Option 2: rebase the seven modified files + ten untracked files into a squashed commit `feat(governance): V2-P00R+P01+P01R remediation stack` on a working branch, then re-invoke.
Option 3: extract only the tracked-source deltas into a commit (leave untracked test/audit files in a separate follow-up commit) and re-invoke V2-P02R against the smaller checkpoint.
not_committed_by_v2_p02r_reason: V2-P02R has no authorization from the operator to make a commit; §2 explicitly maps this case to LIVE_CODE_STATE = DIRTY_UNFROZEN + BLOCK.

content_hash_manifest_summary.note: A commit is the correct immutable identifier; a manifest of file hashes is only a fallback. Recorded here for future auditors.
content_hash_manifest_summary.sha256_index_of_modified_tracked_files: not_computed — a per-file hash without a commit still leaves the working tree mutable and provides no history anchor. Prefer commit.
